current_role: Adviser to Sequoia Capital (steward until November 2025); SpaceX board member (since 2026)
summary: Roelof Botha was PayPal's chief financial officer from 2000 to 2003 and took it public in 2002. He joined Sequoia Capital in 2003, where he oversaw its investments in YouTube, Instagram and Square, and led the firm as steward until stepping aside in November 2025 in favor of Alfred Lin and Pat Grady. In 2026 he joined SpaceX's board, reuniting with Elon Musk.
